name: codeladder
description: CodeLadder turns Python, TypeScript, C, C++, Java, Rust and Go into four readable tiers — intent (L1), steps (L2), logic (L3) and code (L4). Made for AI-assisted developers who ship code they can't fully read, and for anyone learning an unfamiliar codebase.

enumDescriptions: Follow the IDE display language (Chinese → 中文, otherwise English)
codeLadder.language.markdownDescription: Language used by CodeLadder explanations and the panel. `auto` follows the IDE display language.

codeLadder.llm.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Fallback OpenAI-compatible API base URL (e.g. `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`). CodeLadder first tries a language model exposed by the IDE (`vscode.lm`); these settings are used only when none is available. Leave empty to use the deterministic project index only.

codeLadder.llm.apiKey.markdownDescription: API key for the fallback endpoint (stored in plain text; recommended for personal devices only).

editor/context.when: resourceLangId == python || resourceLangId == typescript || resourceLangId == typescriptreact || resourceLangId == c || resourceLangId == cpp || resourceLangId == java || resourceLangId == rust || resourceLangId == go

editor/title.when: resourceLangId == python || resourceLangId == typescript || resourceLangId == typescriptreact || resourceLangId == c || resourceLangId == cpp || resourceLangId == java || resourceLangId == rust || resourceLangId == go
